title: Nanoporous silica · overlapping Si/O atoms · preparation
parts: One connected nanoporous Si/O sphere candidate: 72,500 atoms, full core retained
material: Model filament(s) not selected; PVA support body and interface planned on secondary

source.evidence: Source atomic coordinates: camilla.data SHA256 69e8be921c019d3a860cbf05067aab95129832255816b00fe27282c99de3ba9e. Type identities Si/O/H are inferred from coordination and distances; source provides no element names, bond topology or molecule labels. Selection retains every Si and O within 2.0 Å of any Si using the periodic cell, and removes all H and other O. The H-free selected coordinates SHA256 is 5145761db4e8b85c4e8ad76757913dd47a3448c73c3abc7b2e9c7bfce3e48a97.

notes: The user authorized automatic printing once the exact artifact, material budget and fresh device/camera checks pass. No upload or print start has occurred. The current candidate measures 100.0×99.9833×99.9938mm, uniformly reduced from the203 mm baseline while retaining all 72,500 main-component atoms, the full core and the original Si/O radius ratio. The 882 boundary-fragment exclusions remain recorded; the complete 73,382-atom coordinate visualization is preserved. Scaling repairs removed 38 tiny facets with 17 endpoint substitutions (maximum 0.009535 mm). Independent exported-coordinate, zero-area, directed-edge watertightness, winding and connectivity checks passed, and an actual local surface window was reviewed. The203 mm baseline passed native collision checks but failed cache export after producing diagnostic G-code. Its estimates of 777.97 g PLA, 2759.33 g PVA and 16 d 4 h 48 m 31 s are scoped to that failed attempt and exceed the one-roll PVA budget. A small native probe verified the cache-directory fix and exported both cache JSON and a complete 3MF. The 100 mm full slice is active; its material and duration estimates, exact previews, internal supports and small necks remain to be reviewed. Planning allows 400 g total modeled PVA with 100 g reserve if the roll is full. Nominal 500 g capacity does not overwrite older 50% remaining telemetry; fresh available material must cover the job and reserve. The target is print completion by 17:00 Europe/Oslo on October 26 with margin; feasibility and subsequent PVA removal time are unverified. An 80 mm geometry fallback is prepared but not selected or sliced. Blender images remain coordinate-render evidence, not current slicer previews. The tower-rotation defect is reported in issue 12777 and draft PR 12778; the installed slicer remains unchanged. No physical strength, dryness, successful printing or dissolution claim.
